+++ b/tests/test_explicit_lexer.py
@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+from io import StringIO
+
+import pytest
+
+import sqlparse
+from sqlparse import keywords, tokens as T
+from sqlparse.lexer import Lexer, tokenize
+
+
+def make_lexer():
+    lex = Lexer()
+    lex.clear()
+    lex.set_SQL_REGEX([(r';', T.Whitespace)] + keywords.SQL_REGEX)
+    lex.add_keywords({'SELECT': T.Name, 'BACON': T.Keyword})
+    return lex
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('entry', ['parse', 'parsestream', 'split', 'format', 'tokenize'])
+def test_explicit_lexer(entry):
+    lex = make_lexer()
+    text = 'select 1; select 2;'
+    if entry == 'tokenize':
+        result = list(tokenize(text, lexer=lex))
+        assert result[0] == (T.Name, 'select')
+        assert [tt for tt, value in result if value == ';'] == [T.Whitespace] * 2
+    elif entry == 'format':
+        assert sqlparse.format(text, lexer=lex, keyword_case='upper') == text
+    elif entry == 'split':
+        assert sqlparse.split(text, lexer=lex) == [text]
+        assert sqlparse.split(text, lexer=lex, strip_semicolon=True) == [text[:-1]]
+    else:
+        result = list(getattr(sqlparse, entry)(text, lexer=lex))
+        assert len(result) == 1
+        assert str(result[0]) == text
+    assert len(sqlparse.parse(text)) == 2
+    assert list(tokenize('select')) == [(T.Keyword.DML, 'select')]
+    assert list(tokenize('select', lexer=None)) == [(T.Keyword.DML, 'select')]
+
+
+def test_explicit_lexer_streams_and_bytes():
+    lex = make_lexer()
+    text = 'select 1; select 2;'
+    pending = sqlparse.parsestream(StringIO(text), lexer=lex)
+    assert len(sqlparse.parse(text, lexer=None)) == 2
+    assert [str(stmt) for stmt in pending] == [text]
+    assert sqlparse.split(text.encode('utf-8'), encoding='utf-8', lexer=lex) == [text]
+    assert sqlparse.format(text.encode('utf-8'), encoding='utf-8', lexer=lex,
+                           keyword_case='upper') == text
+    assert [str(stmt) for stmt in sqlparse.parse(text.encode('utf-8'),
+                                               encoding='utf-8', lexer=lex)] == [text]
+    assert list(tokenize(StringIO('BACON'), lexer=lex)) == [(T.Keyword, 'BACON')]
+    assert sqlparse.format('BACON', lexer=lex, keyword_case='lower') == 'bacon'
+    other = Lexer()
+    other.default_initialization()
+    assert list(tokenize('BACON', lexer=other)) == [(T.Name, 'BACON')]
spec.notes: The custom test lexer deliberately classifies semicolons as whitespace and SELECT as Name, making instance propagation observable without importing internal pipeline helpers.
